abinadab_44.name: Abinadab
abinadab_44.who: The second son of Jesse and an older brother of King David.
key: Jesse had Abinadab pass before Samuel, but the LORD had not chosen him (1 Samuel 16).
He was one of Jesse's three oldest sons who followed Saul to fight the Philistines (1 Samuel 17).
He is listed as Jesse's second son, after Eliab (1 Chronicles 2).

adah_69.name: Adah
adah_69.who: One of the two wives of Lamech, a descendant of Cain, and mother of Jabal and Jubal.
key: Lamech took two wives, Adah and Zillah (Genesis 4).
Adah bore Jabal, father of those who live in tents and keep livestock (Genesis 4).
She also bore Jubal, father of all who play the lyre and pipe (Genesis 4).
Lamech addressed his boastful song of vengeance to Adah and Zillah (Genesis 4).

aiah_177.name: Aiah
aiah_177.who: The father of Rizpah, the concubine of King Saul.
key: His daughter Rizpah was a concubine of King Saul (2 Samuel 3).
Ish-bosheth accused Abner of going in to Rizpah daughter of Aiah (2 Samuel 3).
Rizpah's two sons by Saul were handed over to the Gibeonites and put to death (2 Samuel 21).
David was told how Rizpah daughter of Aiah had guarded their bodies (2 Samuel 21).

anath_261.name: Anath
anath_261.who: The father of Shamgar, the deliverer who struck down six hundred Philistines.
key: Shamgar son of Anath killed six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad and saved Israel (Judges 3).
Deborah's song recalls that in the days of Shamgar son of Anath the highways were abandoned (Judges 5).

azbuk_550.name: Azbuk
azbuk_550.who: The father of Nehemiah, the ruler of half of Beth-zur who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall.
key: His son Nehemiah ruled half the district of Beth-zur (Nehemiah 3).
Nehemiah son of Azbuk repaired the wall as far as the tombs of David (Nehemiah 3).

baal_573.name: Baal
baal_573.who: A Canaanite false god whose worship repeatedly led Israel into idolatry.
key: At Shittim Israel yoked itself to Baal of Peor, and the LORD's anger brought a plague (Numbers 25).
Gideon tore down his father's altar to Baal and was called Jerubbaal (Judges 6).
King Ahab married Jezebel and built an altar and a house for Baal in Samaria (1 Kings 16).
On Mount Carmel the LORD answered Elijah with fire, and the prophets of Baal were killed (1 Kings 18).
Jehu gathered Baal's worshipers in his house, destroyed them, and wiped Baal out of Israel (2 Kings 10).
baal_573.label: False god

baal-zebub_579.name: Baal-zebub
baal-zebub_579.who: The god of the Philistine city of Ekron, consulted by King Ahaziah of Israel.
key: After falling through a lattice, Ahaziah sent messengers to ask Baal-zebub whether he would recover (2 Kings 1).
The LORD's angel sent Elijah to ask if there was no God in Israel (2 Kings 1).
Ahaziah died according to the word of the LORD that Elijah had spoken (2 Kings 1).
baal-zebub_579.label: False god

bebai_421.name: Bebai
bebai_421.who: The father, or family head, of Zechariah, who led twenty-eight men back from Babylon with Ezra.
key: Zechariah son of Bebai returned from Babylon to Jerusalem in Ezra's company (Ezra 8).
Twenty-eight men of the family of Bebai were registered with him (Ezra 8).

benaiah_450.name: Benaiah
benaiah_450.who: The father of Pelatiah, a leader of Jerusalem who died while Ezekiel prophesied.
key: In a vision Ezekiel saw Pelatiah son of Benaiah among twenty-five men at the temple's east gate (Ezekiel 11).
As Ezekiel prophesied against them, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died (Ezekiel 11).

beriah_480.name: Beriah
beriah_480.who: A Benjaminite family head in Aijalon who, with Shema, drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
key: Beriah and Shema were heads of fathers' houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon (1 Chronicles 8).
They put to flight the inhabitants of Gath (1 Chronicles 8).
His sons, including Arad, Michael, Ispah, and Joha, are listed in Benjamin's genealogy (1 Chronicles 8).

bimhal_506.name: Bimhal
bimhal_506.who: A man of the tribe of Asher, son of Japhlet, named in Asher's genealogy.
key: Bimhal is named with Pasach and Ashvath as the sons of Japhlet (1 Chronicles 7).
Asher's descendants were heads of fathers' houses and mighty warriors (1 Chronicles 7).

dodo_1021.name: Dodo
dodo_1021.who: An Ahohite, father of Eleazar, one of the three chief warriors among David's mighty men.
key: His son Eleazar was one of the three mighty men who were with David (2 Samuel 23).
Eleazar son of Dodo stood with David against the Philistines at Pas-dammim (1 Chronicles 11).
Dodai the Ahohite, likely the same man, commanded the division for the second month (1 Chronicles 27).

elead_1059.name: Elead
elead_1059.who: A son of Ephraim, killed with Ezer by the men of Gath while raiding their livestock.
key: Ezer and Elead were killed by the men of Gath when they came down to take their livestock (1 Chronicles 7).
Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him (1 Chronicles 7).

elioenai_1135.name: Elioenai
elioenai_1135.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, son of Neariah and father of seven sons.
key: He is listed as a son of Neariah, with his brothers Hizkiah and Azrikam (1 Chronicles 3).
His seven sons are named, including Hodaviah, Eliashib, Johanan, and Anani (1 Chronicles 3).

gaham_1267.name: Gaham
gaham_1267.who: A son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his concubine Reumah.
key: Abraham heard news of the children born to his brother Nahor (Genesis 22).
Nahor's concubine Reumah bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah (Genesis 22).

harbona_1410.name: Harbona
harbona_1410.who: A eunuch of King Ahasuerus who told the king of the gallows Haman had built for Mordecai.
key: He was one of seven eunuchs sent to bring Queen Vashti before the king (Esther 1).
He told the king that Haman had built a gallows fifty cubits high for Mordecai (Esther 7).
The king ordered Haman hanged on that gallows (Esther 7).

hodaviah_1541.name: Hodaviah
hodaviah_1541.who: A Benjaminite, son of Hassenuah, whose descendant Sallu lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: He is listed as son of Hassenuah and father of Meshullam in a Benjaminite line (1 Chronicles 9).
His descendant Sallu son of Meshullam was among the Benjaminites living in Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 9).

iddo_1596.name: Iddo
iddo_1596.who: The leader at Casiphia in Babylonia, to whom Ezra sent for Levites to serve the temple.
key: Finding no Levites among the returnees, Ezra sent men to Iddo, the leading man at Casiphia (Ezra 8).
Iddo's community sent Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and Jeshaiah with other Levites (Ezra 8).
They also sent 220 temple servants to join Ezra's journey (Ezra 8).

iru_615.name: Iru
iru_615.who: A son of Caleb son of Jephunneh, listed in the genealogy of Judah.
key: Iru is named first among the sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh, with Elah and Naam (1 Chronicles 4).
His brother Elah was the father of Kenaz (1 Chronicles 4).

jabesh_674.name: Jabesh
jabesh_674.who: The father of Shallum, who killed King Zechariah of Israel and reigned one month.
key: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against King Zechariah, killed him, and reigned in his place (2 Kings 15).
Shallum son of Jabesh reigned one month in Samaria (2 Kings 15).
Menahem struck down Shallum son of Jabesh and became king (2 Kings 15).

jahdai_701.name: Jahdai
jahdai_701.who: A man of Judah listed among Caleb's descendants, whose six sons are named in Chronicles.
key: His sons were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph (1 Chronicles 2).
He appears in the genealogy of Caleb within the tribe of Judah (1 Chronicles 2).

jamin_721.name: Jamin
jamin_721.who: A man of Judah, son of Ram and grandson of Jerahmeel.
key: Ram was the firstborn son of Jerahmeel (1 Chronicles 2).
The sons of Ram were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker (1 Chronicles 2).

jebusite_748.name: Jebusites
jebusite_748.who: A Canaanite people who held Jerusalem, then called Jebus, until David captured it.
key: The Jebusites are listed among the peoples descended from Canaan (Genesis 10).
The people of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem (Joshua 15).
David captured the stronghold of Zion from the Jebusites, and it became the city of David (2 Samuel 5).
David built an altar on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite (2 Samuel 24).
jebusite_748.label: People group

jerahmeel_844.name: Jerahmeel
jerahmeel_844.who: A Merarite Levite, son of Kish, who headed a family in David's Levite divisions.
key: Jerahmeel is listed as the son of Kish among the Merarite Levites (1 Chronicles 24).
These Levites cast lots before King David, Zadok, and Ahimelech, as their priestly brothers did (1 Chronicles 24).

jobab_1640.name: Jobab
jobab_1640.who: A son of Joktan in Shem's line, named in the Table of Nations.
key: Jobab is listed among the thirteen sons of Joktan, with Ophir and Havilah (Genesis 10).
Chronicles repeats him among the descendants of Shem through Eber (1 Chronicles 1).

johanan_1669.name: Johanan
johanan_1669.who: A priest in Aaron's high priestly line, son of Azariah and father of Azariah.
key: He is listed in the high priestly line as son of Azariah, grandson of Ahimaaz (1 Chronicles 6).
His son Azariah served as priest in the house Solomon built in Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 6).

joiada_1680.name: Joiada
joiada_1680.who: A high priest after the exile, son of Eliashib, whose son married Sanballat's daughter.
key: He is listed in the high priestly line as son of Eliashib and father of Jonathan (Nehemiah 12).
Levite family heads were recorded in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua (Nehemiah 12).
One of his sons became son-in-law to Sanballat, and Nehemiah drove him away (Nehemiah 13).

michael_2060.name: Michael
michael_2060.who: A man of the tribe of Gad, son of Jeshishai, listed in the Gadite genealogy.
key: He appears in the ancestry of Abihail's family as son of Jeshishai and father of Gilead (1 Chronicles 5).
These Gadites were recorded in genealogies in the days of Jotham of Judah and Jeroboam of Israel (1 Chronicles 5).

molech_2104.name: Molech
molech_2104.who: A god of the Ammonites associated with child sacrifice, whose worship the LORD forbade.
key: The law forbade Israel to give any of their children to Molech (Leviticus 18).
Anyone who gave a child to Molech was to be put to death (Leviticus 20).
Solomon built a high place for Molech, the abomination of the Ammonites (1 Kings 11).
Josiah defiled Topheth so that no one could burn a child as an offering to Molech (2 Kings 23).
Judah built high places in the Valley of Hinnom to offer children to Molech (Jeremiah 32).
molech_2104.label: False god

naam_2117.name: Naam
naam_2117.who: A son of Caleb son of Jephunneh, listed in the genealogy of Judah.
key: Naam is named with Iru and Elah as the sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh (1 Chronicles 4).
His brother Elah was the father of Kenaz (1 Chronicles 4).

nahash_2139.name: Nahash
nahash_2139.who: An Ammonite of Rabbah, father of Shobi, probably the Ammonite king who had shown David kindness.
key: His son Shobi came from Rabbah of the Ammonites to meet David at Mahanaim (2 Samuel 17).
Shobi brought beds, bowls, and food for David's people during Absalom's revolt (2 Samuel 17).
He is likely King Nahash, whose kindness David wished to repay to his son Hanun (2 Samuel 10).

philetus_2343.name: Philetus
philetus_2343.who: A false teacher whom Paul named with Hymenaeus for saying the resurrection had already happened.
key: Paul warned that the talk of Hymenaeus and Philetus would spread like gangrene (2 Timothy 2).
They swerved from the truth, saying the resurrection had already happened (2 Timothy 2).
Their teaching was upsetting the faith of some (2 Timothy 2).

shallum_2515.name: Shallum
shallum_2515.who: The keeper of the wardrobe in King Josiah's day and husband of the prophetess Huldah.
key: Hilkiah and the king's officials went to Huldah, wife of Shallum son of Tikvah, keeper of the wardrobe (2 Kings 22).
Chronicles also names Huldah as the wife of Shallum, keeper of the wardrobe (2 Chronicles 34).

shimshai_2707.name: Shimshai
shimshai_2707.who: A scribe in the Persian province Beyond the River who, with Rehum, opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem.
key: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe wrote to Artaxerxes against Jerusalem (Ezra 4).
Artaxerxes replied to Rehum and Shimshai, ordering the work on the city to stop (Ezra 4).
They hurried to Jerusalem and by force made the Jews stop building (Ezra 4).

sosthenes_2772.name: Sosthenes
sosthenes_2772.who: The ruler of the synagogue in Corinth who was beaten in front of Gallio's tribunal.
key: After Gallio dismissed the case against Paul, the crowd seized Sosthenes, the synagogue ruler (Acts 18).
They beat him in front of the tribunal, but Gallio paid no attention (Acts 18).
A brother named Sosthenes, possibly the same man, joined Paul in writing to the Corinthians (1 Corinthians 1).

tiria_2867.name: Tiria
tiria_2867.who: A man of Judah, son of Jehallelel, named in the tribe's genealogy.
key: Tiria is listed among the sons of Jehallelel, with Ziph, Ziphah, and Asarel (1 Chronicles 4).
His family appears among the clans of the tribe of Judah (1 Chronicles 4).

zabdi_2954.name: Zabdi
zabdi_2954.who: A man of Judah, of the clan of Zerah, and grandfather of Achan.
key: Achan son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, took some of the devoted things at Jericho (Joshua 7).
When lots were cast, the household of Zabdi was taken, and then Achan (Joshua 7).

zimran_3086.name: Zimran
zimran_3086.who: A son of Abraham by Keturah, sent away to the east with his brothers.
key: Keturah bore Abraham Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah (Genesis 25).
Abraham gave gifts to these sons and sent them east, away from Isaac (Genesis 25).
Chronicles lists him first among the sons of Keturah (1 Chronicles 1).
